full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 1, the petitioner contested the suit by filing written statements contending, inter alia, that Ausiar Rahman, Tomiz Uddin, Abdul Barik and Altaf All were owner of 63 decimal of land appertaining to RS Plot Nos. 938/ 931 / ka484/ / ka4&3/ 925 // ka481 and 988/kki465 under RS khatian No. 1471. Abdul Batik mortgaged the land of disputed plot No. measuring an area of 15 decimal of land to Ahmed Ali by a registered mortgaged deed No. 331 dated 9-4-1931 and delivered possession to him. That transfer was cancelled due to the law of AK Fazlul Haque. Thereafter, Abdul Barik transferred the disputed land along with other land on receiving Taka 96 by a registered patta deed No. 963 dated 7-5-1941 to the said Ali Ahmed who continued the possession as before he got the possession on the basis of the mortgage deed. Ali Ahmed died leaving wife Mabia Khatun, and one daughter. Maleka Khatun. Maleka Khatun died leaving behind her husband Mofizur Rahman, mother Mabia Khatun including defendant Nos. 1-4 as her heirs. Mabia Khatun sold out her share to Mofizur Rahman. Mofizur Rahman in the above way and by means of amicable settlement got title and possession over the total land of the disputed plot measuring an area of 15 decimal and RS and RS record was prepared in his name correctly without any objection. After his death her son defendant No. 1 got the same by way of inheritance and since other heirs of Mofizur Rahman defendant Nos. 2-4 waived their title in favour of the defendant No. 1. Out of 15 decimal of land 2 decimal was acquired by the government for CUFL Road which was recorded in the name of the government in the BS khatian No. 1 in Plot No. 1800 and defendant No. 1 got the compensation (Award) for the said 2 decimal of land from the government. The plaintiffs have no right, title and possession in the disputed land. The plaintiffs is an influential person who in collusion with the plaintiff created a false deed on 16-5-2004 long after the transfer made by RS recorded tenant Abdul Batik in favour of Ali Ahmed in the year 1931 and 1941 by registered deed Nos. 331 and 963 respectively and filed the test suit for a decree of determination of title and partition which is liable to be dismissed.
